host_suites.name: com.mogu.inspector.crypto.Base91CodecTest
cases: all byte values and varied tails round trip
eight mebibytes of token characters is inclusive and never truncated
source hello and category vectors remain byte exact
invalid characters empty tokens and noncanonical final bits are rejected

host_suites.name: com.mogu.inspector.crypto.Base91JsonDecoderTest
cases: oversized tokens in all wrappers are unchanged without accepting a prefix
complete nested JSON whitespace literals and escaped surrogates remain exact
source JavaScript oracle corpus matches token and response decoding
large complete response keeps its final item
duplicate root data keys are ambiguous and left untouched
supported root fields decode independently in either order without rewriting other text
reprocessing normal decoded response shapes is a no-op
one call decodes one layer and leaves inner tokens alone
ordinary JSON invalid input and non-string data remain verbatim
bad tails and every truncation of the category vector fail
bad optional profiles never prevent data decoding and bad data never prevents profiles
strict UTF8 rejects invalid sequences rather than substituting characters
all three wrappers preserve Unicode escapes and numeric lexemes
duplicate supported keys affect only that field and nested or unknown strings stay encoded
complete JSON grammar and object or array roots are required
only root data is replaced regardless of key order or nesting
JSON string escapes are resolved before decoding token
